comment: Gzip byte budgets for the website build (improvement list S47, L27, A93). Measured 8 Nov 2026: first-load JS 70.2 kB, first-load CSS 28.1 kB, largest chunk 349.6 kB (pdf.js and pdf-lib, loaded only by the bank and exports), all JS 744.2 kB. Each budget has a little headroom; lower a budget when a change makes the site smaller. Raised totalJs 9 Nov 2026 for the Worksheets page (wave 3): PDFKit browser build 214.6 kB, Anthropic SDK 86.2 kB and OpenAI SDK 90.2 kB, all lazy-loaded only when a teacher downloads a worksheet PDF or uses Make with AI; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1199.1 kB. Raised totalJs 10 Nov 2026 for the Gemini provider in Make with AI: Google GenAI SDK browser build 76.6 kB, lazy-loaded only when a teacher chooses Gemini; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1277.2 kB. Raised totalJs 11 Nov 2026 for the Booklets page: BookletPage chunk 23.4 kB, lazy-loaded only on /booklets, reusing the worksheet PDF and AI chunks; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1334.3 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for booklet Word files: the booklet Word writer chunk 11.9 kB and the resvg WebAssembly loader, both lazy-loaded only when a teacher downloads a booklet Word file; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1373.6 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the construction and elevations diagram families (GM8): about 12 kB of cores reach the lazy-loaded Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1401.1 kB with main's 14 Nov additions. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the final-standard tool work queued together: graph point coordinates, shapes, gradient triangles and inequality regions (about 2 kB each in the lazy graph editor chunk), cubic/reciprocal/exponential tables of values, number-line second scales, and the new lazy-loaded two-way table page; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1394.2 kB before GM8 with the first three; lower this once the queue has merged and been measured. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the constructions and plans-and-elevations website editors: two pages lazy-loaded only on /tools/construction and /tools/elevations; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1437.5 kB. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for the two-way table editor (U97): a page lazy-loaded only on /tools/two-way-table, plus its core reaching the lazy Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1455.3 kB with the whole final-standard queue merged. Raised totalJs 14 Nov 2026 for worked-solution notes in the editors (U116): the shared Worked notes dialog and the worked-note layer reach the eight lazy-loaded editors with an answers copy; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1467.2 kB. Raised totalJs 15 Nov 2026 for pie charts, pictograms and scatter graphs in Statistical charts (S-2, S-3, S-5): chart-core grew by their renderers, which reach the lazy-loaded charts editor and the Worksheets and Booklets pages through the shared diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1477.6 kB. Raised totalJs 15 Nov 2026 for the angle diagrams tool: its page (9.2 kB) lazy-loaded only on /tools/angles, plus its core reaching the lazy Worksheets and Booklets pages and the editors' shared chunk through the diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1490.5 kB. Raised totalJs to 1,540,000 on 15 Nov 2026 for the area and perimeter tool: its page lazy-loaded only on /tools/area, plus its core reaching the Worksheets and Booklets pages and the editors' shared chunk through the diagram registry; first-load JS is unchanged. Measured all JS 1518.3 kB.
